sentences.en: We know how completely engrossed children become in games.
sentences.zh: 我们知道孩子们在玩游戏时会完全投入。

sentences.en: The boy was engrossed in constructing a model plane.
sentences.zh: 那个男孩专心致志地组装飞机模型。

sentences.en: When you were a student were you ever completely engrossed in something?
sentences.zh: 你当学生的时候有没有什么东西曾让你完全沉迷？
